entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Do you have a moment? I'd like to[n]share something interesting.
I'm listening.
How interesting?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: There's a certain man in police[n]custody, awaiting trial...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: His accuser is a member of the[n]Diet. According to his claims, the[n]man assaulted him.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But I suspect they're false charges.[n]Something about the accusation[n]doesn't ring true.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A false charge by a Diet member?[n]Wait, that's just like...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perhaps you can sympathize.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: After all, it's not too far removed[n]from your own unfortunate story.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: With one crucial difference:

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Why hasn't the accused spoken[n]up in his own defense?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: At this rate, a guilty verdict[n]seems inevitable.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: There has to be some hidden[n]reason behind all this.
So why tell me?
We can't ignore this.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, considering what you and[n]your group do, I imagine you could[n]hardly abandon him to his fate...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I simply found the information,[n]and thought you might like to do[n]something about it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'd expect no less. Indeed, you can[n]be rather predictable sometimes.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Still as high-and-mighty as ever...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But he's right. We can't just turn a blind[n]eye to this.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, I don't care if Akechi's kind of[n]manipulating us into this. We should[n]help this guy out.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The man worked part-time at the[n]Beef Bowl shop on Central Street.[n]The "assault" occurred there too.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I think that might be a good[n]place to start investigating.
What about you, Akechi?
You're helping too.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, I'll be helping in my own way.[n]Something about it's been on my[n]mind.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'll be looking into this alleged[n]victim, the Diet member. If I find[n]anything, you'll be first to know.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Naturally. I've had a plan in[n]mind myself.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'll look into this alleged victim—[n]the Diet member. If I find anything[n]actionable, I'll let you know.
Got it.
No slacking off.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'll be counting on you to[n]find some usable info.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, I know. Remember, I am[n]a detective myself.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay. First order of business is gathering[n]information. Once we loop the team in,[n]we can start investigating.
